On 2026-08-07 I committed: Add Aloud: a mobile TTS reader with a voice bench.
14 files changed.

A standalone, self-contained page — no dependencies, no network, no build step to use it. Text is read with the voices already on the device and never leaves it. It is two tools because mobile speech engines are broken in ways feature detection cannot see: speechSynthesis is always present, every method exists, and every one returns without complaint. You have to speak something and time it. The reader is built around six measured failures — Android Chrome truncating a single utterance at ~15s, getVoices() empty on the first call, pause() that either does nothing or stops outright, absent…
